assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original raster reveal-background for the Xonix-style game Reveal Line, campaign Fractured Grid, mission First fracture. Create one wide landscape composition, approximately 2:1 aspect ratio. Scene: a weathered coastal flood-control station where a broad, intact stone landing projects into a calm tidal basin; a small broken section of an older embankment exposes layered stone and water beyond. Subject: the contrast between a dependable landing and repairable surrounding ground, with a brass survey instrument and a quiet repair crane as secondary discoveries, no people. Style: crafted contemporary pixel-art-inspired environment illustration with clearly grouped forms, restrained detail, tactile stone and oxidized metal, not a screenshot or a game board. Palette: blue-grey stone and muted sea-green water with small warm copper and cream accents. Lighting: soft early morning haze, readable silhouettes and gentle contrast. Composition: a distinct station focal structure away from the exact center, interesting small discoveries on both sides for progressive picture revelation, open low-frequency water and paving around the focal forms so a bright trail and enemy silhouettes remain readable when the game overlays them. Full bleed, opaque background. Constraints: original composition, no copied reference-game artwork; no grid, HUD, UI, labels, text, numbers, logos, borders, arrows, collectible symbols, characters, enemy sprites, neon lines, or artificial hazard indicators. Architectural lines should be natural perspective, not aligned to a collision grid. This is decorative art only and must not depict playable collision geometry.
assets.editPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is the edit target for the First fracture reveal-background in Reveal Line. Change only the circular emblem on the cloth banner hanging from the central station: remove the emblem, leaving that banner as plain weathered blue fabric with natural shading and no markings. Preserve everything else exactly: landscape framing, image dimensions and 2:1 aspect ratio, station architecture, crane, water, stone embankment, palette, lighting, texture, all objects and their locations. No new symbols, text, logos, UI or borders.

observations: The edited image removes the circular banner emblem from the generated first pass.
An intact stone landing and broken embankment express permanence versus repair without authoring collision.
The scene is a detailed stylized illustration rather than strict low-resolution pixel art.
Crane, station, foreground ruins and distant structures distribute discoveries across the composition. Water and sky provide quieter regions.
No copied reference artwork, interface, visible text, grid or enemy sprites were supplied or requested.
